info.name: Griffion - Public Registration Examples
info.description: Examples showing how public registration works with single or multiple public roles

request.description:
Register user WITHOUT specifying role.
System auto-assigns first available public role.

Example:
- If roles are [Buyer, Seller] ordered by name
- User gets assigned: Buyer (first alphabetically)

Useful for:
- Simple single-role apps
- Default role assignment

Register user WITH specific role parameter.
System verifies role is public type.
If public: registration succeeds with that role.

Required:
- Role must exist in database
- Role must have registrationType = 'public'

Example Setup:
- Role: Buyer (registrationType: public)
- User registers: Jane → Gets Buyer role

Useeful for:
- Marketplace apps (Buyer vs Seller)
- Multi-role SaaS (Customer vs Free vs Premium)
- Choice-based signup

Another example: Register as different public role.

Scenario:
- Marketplace has 2 public roles
- Users can choose which to register as
- Buyer: browsing/purchasing permissions
- Seller: listing/inventory permissions

Each gets different capabilities based on role permissions.

item.name: 4. Try to Register as Admin (FAILS - Not Public)

request.description:
ATTEMPT to register with admin-only role.

Result: 400 Error
Message: Role "Admin" is not available for self-registration

Why?
- Admin role has registrationType = 'admin'
- Only 'public' roles allow self-registration
- Only admins can create admin/staff users

This ensures security - users can't give themselves admin access.

item.name: 5. Get Available Public Roles (For Signup Form)

request.description:
Get all available roles to populate signup form.

Response includes:
- id: Role ID
- name: Role name (Buyer, Seller, etc)
- registrationType: 'public', 'admin', or 'custom'
- description: What this role does
- permissions: Array of granted permissions

Frontend Usage:
1. Call this endpoint
2. Filter for registrationType = 'public'
3. Build dropdown: Buyer, Seller, Guest, etc
4. User picks one
5. Send registration request with chosen role

Note: Admin/custom roles won't appear in public signup dropdown (different registrationType).

### How to set up public roles in database:

```sql
-- Example: Marketplace with 2 public roles
INSERT INTO Role (name, registrationType, description) VALUES
('Buyer', 'public', 'Can browse and purchase items'),
('Seller', 'public', 'Can list and sell items'),
('Manager', 'admin', 'Platform manager - admin only'),
('Admin', 'admin', 'System administrator');

-- Verify:
SELECT name, registrationType FROM Role WHERE registrationType = 'public';
-- Returns: Buyer, Seller (these are available for self-signup)

-- When user registers with role='Seller':
-- System checks: WHERE name='Seller' AND registrationType='public'
-- Found: ✓ Registration succeeds

-- When user registers with role='Manager':
-- System checks: WHERE name='Manager' AND registrationType='public'
-- Not found: ✗ Returns 400 error
```

### Single Public Role (Simple Apps)

```sql
INSERT INTO Role (name, registrationType) VALUES
('User', 'public');

-- All users self-register as 'User'
-- No role selection needed
-- Frontend: Don't show role dropdown
```

### Complex Setup (Enterprise)

```sql
-- Public: Only guests can self-signup
INSERT INTO Role (name, registrationType) VALUES
('Guest', 'public');

-- Admin only: Company assigns these
INSERT INTO Role (name, registrationType) VALUES
('Employee', 'admin'),
('Manager', 'admin'),
('Executive', 'admin');

-- User flow:
-- 1. Guest self-registers via public role
-- 2. Admin upgrades Guest → Employee
-- 3. Admin can create direct as Manager/Executive
```
